Search for all of your Amazon goodies, really really fast. As you type, it predicts your term and searches Amazon for products, showing the results instantly.
A real-time list of the most recent tweets and Flickr photos concerning beds and bedrooms. More feeds to come.

The simplest youtube radio or media player. Just type the name of an artist or song or style of music, press Go, and let BlahBlahBleh play you music videos from youtube related to your search. Like Last.fm or pandora, but lightweight.

Lose It! is a mobile application related to weight loss available on Google Play and Apple iTunes. Besides identity, location, media, and camera, the app also needs access to In-app purchases. Once installed, the app asks for user weight, followed by goal weight, gender, height, and weight plan.
Zendesk for voice. Talkdesk is a powerful voice customer support system. Answer customer support calls in the browser.
A real estate website from Denmark that uses Google Maps for tracking the houses for sale or rent on the map.
Earth Album is a google maps and YouTube mash-up that allows you to tour the videospace of the world via YouTube tags.
Small community that uses the Youtube API to show off and comment on videos in users profiles.
The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.

The Inside Big Data Mashup processes and filters high volumes of data from a variety of sources in the web. The mashup identifies data sources, such as news and blogs, in addition to summarizing the breakdown of metadata associated to the sources. This way, users can access important descriptive data such as dates, visitor counts, and comments attributable to particular sources of data.
